title: The Lord's Warning to the Priests and the Covenant with Levi
description: The Lord issues a stern warning to the priests because they do not honor His name, and threatens to send a curse upon them. He reminds them of the covenant with Levi, who feared the Lord, upheld the law of truth on his lips, and turned many away from sin. The priests, however, have strayed from the path, caused many to stumble, and broken the covenant; therefore, they have been despised by the people.
